meta.description: Synthetic phone call scripts for evaluating Palisade's scam scorer. All organizations, names and amounts are fictional. Scam scripts follow commonly documented scam patterns; to add realism, add more scripts based on public scam-awareness materials rather than copying creators' recordings.
meta.speakers: caller = the person who phoned the senior; senior = the protected person
meta.t: approximate seconds from call start when the turn begins
meta.trigger_turn: index of the earliest turn where a careful listener should call the call a likely scam (a judgment call). null for legitimate calls.
meta.label: scam or legit. Legit scripts marked adversarial deliberately contain scam-like vocabulary (fraud, payment, personal details) to test false alarms.

scripts.label: scam
scripts.notes: Threat of arrest, stay on the line, secrecy, then gift cards.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, this is Officer Daniels with the Federal Benefits Office. Am I speaking with the account holder?

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: Yes, this is me. What is this about?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Your benefits number has been flagged for suspicious activity and it will be suspended today.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: Suspended? I don't understand.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: There is a warrant connected to your account. To avoid arrest you must stay on the line and not hang up.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: Oh my. What do I need to do?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Do not discuss this with anyone, including your bank or family, because it could compromise the investigation.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: Okay, I won't tell anyone.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Go to your nearest store and buy gift cards worth three thousand dollars, then read me the numbers on the back.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: Gift cards? Is that normal?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, it is a secure government process. You must hurry, the deadline is in one hour.

scripts.label: scam
scripts.notes: Classic safe-account transfer with verification avoidance and secrecy.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Good afternoon, this is the fraud prevention team at your bank. We detected a suspicious transfer from your savings account.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: Oh no, I didn't make any transfer.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: To protect your money we need to move your funds into a secure holding account right away.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: How do I do that?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I will give you the account number. Please go to your branch or use your app and wire the full balance now.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: Should I call my bank first to check?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: There is no time. Calling will alert the criminals who have access to your account. Please do not tell the teller why you are wiring the money.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: Alright, I'm getting my coat.

scripts.label: scam
scripts.notes: Slow burn: starts benign. Tests the rolling window and previous_risk. Remote access then a prepaid card charge.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, I'm calling from Windows technical support. We are seeing error reports coming from your computer.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: Really? It has been running slow lately.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, that is a virus. I can fix it for you over the phone right now. Are you near your computer?

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: I'm sitting at it now.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Great. Please open your web browser and download a remote access program that I will name for you.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: Okay, what do I click?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Install it and read me the nine digit code it shows, so I can connect to your computer and remove the virus.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: It's showing a code. Should I give it to you?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes. After that there is a one-time charge of two hundred dollars, which you can pay with a prepaid card.

scripts.label: scam
scripts.notes: Caller never names themselves; the senior supplies the name. Bail money, secrecy, cash pickup.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Grandma? It's me. Please don't be upset.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: Who is this? Michael?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, it's Michael. I'm in trouble. I was in a car accident and the police arrested me.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: Oh my goodness, are you hurt?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I'm okay, but I need bail money right away. Please don't tell Mom and Dad, they'll be so angry.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: How much do you need?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Eight thousand dollars. A bail agent will come to your house to pick up the cash. Please hurry.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: I'll go to the bank now.

scripts.label: scam
scripts.notes: Shutoff threat with a short deadline and prepaid card payment.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: This is the electric company billing department. Your account is past due and your power will be shut off in thirty minutes.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: I thought I paid last week.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Our records show no payment. To keep your power on you must pay right now with a prepaid debit card.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: A prepaid card? I usually pay online.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The online system is down. Go to the nearest drugstore, buy a card for four hundred dollars, and call me back with the number on it.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: Okay, I'll go right now.

scripts.label: scam
scripts.notes: Fee required to receive winnings, wire or crypto, secrecy.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Congratulations! You have won two million dollars in the national sweepstakes.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: Really? I don't remember entering.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Your name was selected automatically. To release the prize you only need to pay the processing fee and taxes first.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: How much is the fee?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Nine hundred dollars by wire transfer or cryptocurrency. Do not tell your family until the winnings arrive, so they can't interfere.

scripts.label: scam
scripts.notes: Credential harvesting: full ID number, SSN and bank account.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, I'm calling about your new Medicare benefits card. Are you the person who receives benefits at this address?

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: Yes, I am.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: We are issuing new cards, and yours will be canceled unless I verify your information today.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: What information do you need?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Please read me your full Medicare number, your social security number, and the bank account where you want your refund deposited.

scripts.label: scam
scripts.notes: One-time code request. The senior even reads the code's own warning aloud.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi, this is the security department at your credit card company. Did you just try to spend nine hundred dollars at an electronics store?

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: No, I didn't.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Okay, I will block it. For verification we are sending you a six digit code by text. Please read it to me when it arrives.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: It just came. It says not to share this code with anyone.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: That message is only for fraudsters. Please read me the code so I can cancel the charge.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, this is Riverside Pharmacy calling for Margaret. Your prescription refill is ready for pickup.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: Oh good, thank you. What time are you open until?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: We're open until eight tonight. Please bring your photo ID when you pick it up.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: I'll come by this afternoon.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Wonderful. Have a good day.

scripts.label: legit
scripts.notes: Adversarial: mentions insurance card and a copay.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi, this is Dr. Patel's office confirming your appointment on Thursday at ten thirty.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: Yes, I'll be there.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Please arrive fifteen minutes early to update your forms, and bring your insurance card.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: Will do. Is there a copay?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Your copay is twenty dollars, which you can pay at the front desk when you arrive.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: That's fine. Thank you.

scripts.label: legit
scripts.notes: Adversarial: automated bank fraud alert that says it will never ask for a password and tells the senior to hang up and call the number on the card.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: This is an automated fraud alert from First Community Bank. We noticed a charge of eighty-two dollars at a hardware store. Did you make this purchase? Say yes or no.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: Yes.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Thank you. We have marked the charge as approved. We will never ask for your password or full card number by phone. If you are unsure about any call, hang up and dial the number on the back of your card.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: Okay, thanks.

scripts.label: legit
scripts.notes: Family call that mentions a favor but no money or secrecy.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi Grandma, it's Emma! Are you still free to drive me to practice on Saturday?

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: Of course, sweetheart. What time?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Nine o'clock. Mom said she'll text you the address.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: Wonderful. Do you need anything else?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Just a hug. Also, I got an A on my science test!

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: Oh, I'm so proud of you!

scripts.label: legit
scripts.notes: Adversarial: utility call with no payment demand and no pressure.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: This is Maple Valley Electric with a service notice. There will be a planned outage in your area Tuesday from nine to eleven in the morning for maintenance.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: Is it just for a couple of hours?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes. Power should be restored by eleven. No action is needed. Visit our website or call the number on your bill for updates.

scripts.label: legit
scripts.notes: Short, practical call from a driver.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi, I'm outside with a package for apartment 4B but the buzzer isn't working. Could you come down or let me in?

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: Oh, I'll buzz you in from here. One moment.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Thanks so much. I'll leave it at the door.

scripts.label: legit
scripts.notes: Adversarial: mentions a premium due date and payment options, with no urgency or unusual payment method.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, this is Greg from Blue Harbor Insurance, your agent. Your home policy renews on the first of next month.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: Yes, I got the letter.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Great. Your premium is due on the fifteenth. You can pay through your online account, mail a check, or call our main office.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: I'll mail a check.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: That works. Let me know if you'd like to review your coverage before the renewal.

scripts.label: legit
scripts.notes: Adversarial: asks for date of birth for identity check and discusses a balance and payment plan, but offers to mail a statement and applies no pressure.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, this is the billing office at St. Mary's Hospital. I'm calling about a statement from your March visit. Is this Robert?

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: Yes.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: For privacy, can you confirm your date of birth?

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: March third, nineteen fifty-one.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Thank you. Your remaining balance is one hundred fifty dollars. We can mail a statement, and there is a payment plan if you would like one.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: Please mail it to me and I'll think about the plan.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Of course. We'll send it this week.
